messages:
Sam: inbound security questionnaire from GlimmerPay — attached SIG/CAIQ PDF. they also asked about BYOK, SOC2, pen test reports. timeline: asked for answers by Friday EOD PST. who can own?
Aisha: @Marco can you take this? looks like a standard sales intake but tight timeline.
Marco: I can own. do we have a prefilled SIG template for sales to reuse or should I start from scratch?
Sam: there's a customer-specific section about dedicated/private deployment requirements (VPC peering, data residency). POC starts next week.
Devon: For the deployment Qs we usually reference the dedicated/private playbook. I can pull relevant snippets.
Priya: I’ll handle crypto/KMS and key rotation Qs — they asked about BYOK and HSM.
Marco: thanks. @Priya can you paste the KMS language you want included?
Priya: draft: "We support customer-managed keys via KMS integrations; HSM-backed key storage is available for Private deployments. BYOK workflows are supported via envelope encryption and customer key import."
Sam: perfect. Also they want SOC2 and latest pentest PDF attachments.
Priya: I have links to SOC2 cert + pentest redacted report — will attach.
Marco: creating answers doc now and a short CSV for the sales team. putting initial draft in the ticket.
secbot: New security intake ticket created: SEC-5123. Owner: Marco. Priority: High.
Aisha: FYI sales asked for a pricing ballpark if they need dedicated capacity (~10k qps peak) — @Devon can you give a quick estimate to include in the response?
Devon: quick ballpark: reserved + burst for that qps is ~ $85k/month depending on model/quantization. I’ll send a tidy note to Sam for the customer-facing reply.
Marco: question for legal — they want to add a clause about data deletion timelines in the contract. loop legal?
Aisha: looping @Jane from legal to weigh in on deletion SLA language.
Jane: thanks — I’ll review proposed SLA text. default is 30 days for hosted, but for Dedicated/Private we can negotiate 7–30 days depending on contract.
Marco: added note: we need a short architecture diagram for the CAIQ network answers. Devon, can you drop a PNG in the ticket?
Devon: yep uploading now.
Sam: target to submit questionnaire by Thu COB so we have buffer before their Fri deadline.
Marco: will try to have the first pass by Wed afternoon, flagging any blocked questions.
Priya: done with crypto section, uploaded link: https://drive.redwood/security/glimmerpay/crypto.
Marco: added SOC2 + pentest links to answers. one unanswered item remains: customer wants proof of data-in-transit key rotation schedule. ops team who owns that?
Aisha: @Priya maybe ops doc? or @Devon knows where to pull rotation schedule.
Priya: Ops rotation schedule is in the runbook; I can excerpt the section.
secbot: SEC-5123 updated: status -> in_progress; assignee -> Marco.
Marco: logging times/ETA in the ticket. will ping if we need more info from the customer.
Sam: thanks everyone — @Aisha please confirm when you want this sent to the customer and whether to include the pricing caveat.
Aisha: send after Marco marks it ready. include pricing caveat: "estimates subject to final sizing and model selection." :thumbsup:
